gen-gf-lemonada-instrument-sans: Lemonada stands low and tight, its lines drawn with no swelling at all and its letters spaced like teeth on a comb. Instrument Sans then reads smoothly, its strokes never varying.
gen-gf-lemonada-inter: Inter has counters that breathe and a smooth, tube-like line, tall in the lowercase. But Lemonada is built to announce, with commanding, expressive lines, while Inter is built to carry the text.
gen-gf-lemonada-poppins: Expressive, with letters spaced like teeth on a comb, Lemonada draws every stroke without any swelling. Poppins carries on with rope-loose curves and a sturdy lowercase that never snags.
gen-gf-lemonada-roboto-slab: A line with no swelling anywhere, spaced like wide-set teeth on a comb, gives Lemonada its look. Roboto Slab, a precise slab-serif with open throats, gives the pair its real tension: structure against flourish.
gen-gf-lemonada-rubik: A thread of ink with no swelling or tapering gives Lemonada its low, tight look. Rubik sits beside it with soft, open round letters and a big lowercase that stay clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-libertinus-sans-fs-literata: Modern and friendly: Libertinus Sans draws its horizontals slightly slimmer than its verticals. And Literata, sturdy and bookish, brings wide-mouthed curves and a thin-line firmness that give the pairing its sophisticated pull.
gen-gf-libertinus-serif-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and editorial, Libertinus Serif writes with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut and swells gently. Bespoke Sans sits sharp and refined beneath, leaving generous gaps at its curves.
gen-gf-libre-caslon-text-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, a sharp sans-serif counterweight to the authoritative Libre Caslon Text. Paragraphs of it move along smoothly and without any fuss.
gen-gf-libre-franklin-fs-literata: An e that opens up rather than closing its eye gives Libre Franklin a clean, unfussy face before Literata arrives. Literata then reads with bookish ease, wide-mouthed curves guiding the eye.
gen-gf-lilex-fs-bespoke-sans: Fixed-width, code-style letters with long gaps between them give Lilex a precise, technical look. Bespoke Sans then loosens things with sharp, refined lines and generous room around its curves.
